zh.title: 发布状态
items: **0.1.0-rc.6** 是供负责人评测界面与交互细节的候选版。正式版仍为 0.0.18，npm beta 仍为 0.1.0-beta.5；全面评测、连续七天日用及明确批准后才发布正式 0.1.0。
保留此前机器人、任务、目标、记忆、TUI、远程、更新和诊断功能。复杂写任务的 Evidence 核验缺口仍未 Ready，候选发布不代表总体验收完成。

zh.title: 本次改进
items: 统一 Frost 设置、机器人对话和档案的字体、信息层级、标题带、间距与表面。浅深色共用灰底控件，普通控件取消常驻描边与阴影；弹出菜单使用轻阴影，保留键盘焦点、选中和禁用状态。
控件使用连续曲线与分级圆角：普通控件 12 px、紧凑控件 8 px、分组和浮层 16 px。下拉箭头固定右端；窄窗自动改为纵向设置行与双列模型角色。侧栏底部分隔线贯穿可用宽度，版本保持在右端。
用户消息在右侧，机器人在左侧显示真实身份，回执位于正文下方。回复引用提供摘要和原消息定位，过程与证据采用弱操作；选择回答跟随所属消息，自由输入后收起原选项和需要你计数。
保留逐段流式回复和停止生成；停止后保留已生成文字、未完成标记与输入草稿。过程默认展示可读动作，原始参数在技术详情内。
机器人输入框恢复文件选择、图片粘贴和拖放入口，支持预览、移除、只发附件与重启回显。附件沿已有授权与事实链进入用户消息；委托只传递锚定消息材料。
每个机器人可直接选择对话模型及推理强度，档案与输入框共享状态。生成期间保持本轮配置快照，下一轮使用新配置；任务执行和复核分别配置，继承来源保持可见。
档案五个分区使用可滑动的分段选择器，支持方向键、Home/End、焦点归还及减少动效。修复返回通用设置时读取启动旧值的问题。

zh.title: 升级与评测
items: RC4/RC5 用户可在“设置 → 更新与关于”通过自动或 Beta 通道检查 RC6。旧 Beta5/RC1–3 更新器有已知选版错误，须从本页手动下载匹配架构的安装包，不接受旧 Beta 降级提示。
退出旧宿主并备份完整数据根；Desktop、CLI/TUI 与 Gateway 同步升级，不需要重置数据。设置 → 通用 → 界面可切回经典界面。
npm 固定版本使用 `@peer-agent/cli@0.1.0-rc.6`，`@rc` 跟随后续候选。macOS CLI 归档的 peer 和同次签名凭据助手保持同目录。

使用[全面测试手册](https://github.com/ly-ccx/Peer-Knowledge/blob/PeerKnowledge/pa/rc-05-docs/playbook/v0.1.0/acceptance-test-guide.md)和[RC6 交接记录](https://github.com/ly-ccx/Peer-Knowledge/blob/PeerKnowledge/pa/rc-05-docs/playbook/v0.1.0/rc6-candidate.md)。预期行为与实测结果分开记录。

zh.title: 验证与已知限制
items: 本机完整构建、类型、架构与自动回归通过；两平台 CI 另包含隔离 Electron 窗口、模型与附件事实链、焦点、更新状态和性能预算检查。签名包、实际更新清单和发布产物核对记录在交接文件。
原生实机使用生产 renderer 与隔离数据，模型输出为受控 Provider。它能证明请求配置、附件转交、流式及停止行为，不代表真实订阅模型质量、所有图片解析或实际网络稳定性。
复杂写任务的实际命令描述仍可能未完整进入 Evidence 快照，独立核验会拒绝结果；保持拒绝，这项仍阻塞总体 Ready 与 GA。
Windows/Linux 交互安装、生产远程部署、实体手机、跨应用文件拖放、超大附件、全量读屏和七天日用仍需对应环境实测。远程仅文本且电脑在线，批准留在本地；目标 token 硬限尚未实现并拒绝配置。

en.title: Release status
items: **0.1.0-rc.6** is a candidate for detailed owner evaluation of the interface and interactions. Stable remains 0.0.18 and npm beta remains 0.1.0-beta.5. Version 0.1.0 requires comprehensive testing, seven days of daily use and explicit approval.

Existing bots, tasks, objectives, memory, TUI, remote input, updates and diagnostics remain. The complex-write Evidence verification gap remains not ready; this release does not establish overall acceptance.

en.title: Improvements
items: Unify Frost settings, conversations and profiles with shared typography, hierarchy, group headings, spacing and surfaces. Light/dark controls use gray fills without idle outlines or shadows; floating menus have a subtle shadow. Keyboard focus, selection and disabled states remain visible.

Use continuous corners with a 12 px standard, 8 px compact and 16 px group/menu radius. Keep dropdown arrows at the right edge. Narrow settings stack vertically and model roles use two columns. The sidebar footer divider spans its available width and the version stays at the right.

Place user messages on the right and bot replies with their identity on the left. Receipts sit below the text. Reply context locates its source; process and evidence use secondary controls. Choices stay with their message and collapse after free-form answers, including the needs-you count.
Retain incremental replies and stop generation. Stopping preserves partial text, an incomplete marker and the draft. Process steps use readable labels with raw arguments under technical details.

Restore file selection, image paste and drop entry points with preview, removal, attachment-only sending and restart restoration. Attachments follow the existing authorization and factual chain; delegation carries only material anchored to the relevant input.

Select each bot's conversation model and reasoning effort directly, with shared composer/profile state. Active turns retain their model snapshot; changed settings apply to subsequent turns. Execution and verification remain independent, with visible inheritance.
Use a sliding segmented profile control with arrow keys, Home/End, focus restoration and reduced motion. Reopening General now reads saved preferences rather than the startup snapshot.

en.title: Upgrade and evaluation
items: RC4/RC5 users can check for RC6 through Auto or Beta in Settings → Update & About. Older Beta5/RC1–3 updaters have known selection errors and require a manual matching-architecture installer from this page; decline older Beta downgrade prompts.
Quit older hosts, back up the complete data root and upgrade Desktop, CLI/TUI and Gateway together. No reset is required. Settings → General → Interface restores classic chat.
Install the fixed npm version with `@peer-agent/cli@0.1.0-rc.6`; `@rc` follows later candidates. Keep the macOS archive's peer and signed credential helper together.

Follow the [comprehensive guide](https://github.com/ly-ccx/Peer-Knowledge/blob/PeerKnowledge/pa/rc-05-docs/playbook/v0.1.0/acceptance-test-guide.md) and [RC6 handoff](https://github.com/ly-ccx/Peer-Knowledge/blob/PeerKnowledge/pa/rc-05-docs/playbook/v0.1.0/rc6-candidate.md). Record expected behavior and actual results separately.

en.title: Validation and known limits
items: Full local build, type, architecture and regression checks pass. Both CI platforms also cover isolated Electron windows, model/attachment factual paths, focus, updater states and performance budgets. Signed packages, live update manifests and release assets are recorded in the handoff.

Native inspection uses the production renderer and isolated data with a controlled Provider. It demonstrates request configuration, attachment forwarding, streaming and stopping, rather than subscription-model quality, every image format or live network stability.

Executed-command descriptors for complex writes may remain incomplete in Evidence snapshots, causing independent verification to reject results. Rejection remains enforced; this still blocks overall readiness and GA.

Interactive Windows/Linux installation, production remote deployment, physical phones, cross-app drops, oversized attachments, complete screen-reader testing and seven-day use require their corresponding environments. Remote input is text only while the computer is online, with local approvals. Objective token hard limits remain unsupported and rejected.
